description.p: Surf Settings changes the theme, accent colour, wallpaper, fonts, window layout, bar, key bindings and default apps of the surfd desktop. It edits the same plain-text surfd.toml file as the surfctl command, keeping your comments, and applies every change immediately.
surfd is based on Fedora Linux but is not an official Fedora project.
The surfd look for Settings, Welcome and the installer, and pages for flyouts, night light, do not disturb, capture, clipboard history and updates.
